question: What is the average number of taxi and ride-hail trips per day in New York City in October 2026 (yellow taxis, green taxis and high-volume for-hire vehicles combined, as counted by the NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission)?

target.what: Average daily count of trips by yellow taxis, green taxis (Boro Taxis), and high-volume for-hire vehicles (HVFHV: Uber, Lyft, and similar) in New York City, combined, as recorded in NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission trip-record data
target.publisher: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC)
target.cadence: Monthly trip-record data files (Parquet), typically published with a lag of roughly 1-3 months after month end; TLC also publishes monthly summary reports
target.caveats: Target period is in the future relative to the 2026-10-17 cutoff, so no observed value exists; must be forecast. Working interpretation: mean of daily trip counts across all 31 days of October 2026 (total October trips / 31), combining yellow, green, and HVFHV only (excludes other FHVs such as black

candidates.perspective: TLC data publisher / analyst tracking monthly trip totals
candidates.hypothesis: October 2026 daily average will be close to recent monthly daily averages (e.g., 2024-2025 October and adjacent months) adjusted for trend and seasonality; October typically shows a modest seasonal dip versus summer peak and a rise versus winter trough. The most recent published months before cutoff anchor the level.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly total trips (or average daily trips) for yellow, green, and HVFHV combined for October in 2023, 2024, 2025 and for the most recent months published before 2026-10-17 (e.g., mid-2026). Minimum: monthly totals by vehicle class for at least the last 12-24 months to estimate level, trend, and October seasonal factor.
search_hints: NYC TLC monthly trip data yellow green high volume for-hire totals
TLC taxi and for-hire vehicle trip record data monthly summary 2025
NYC TLC October trips yellow cab HVFHV

candidates.hypothesis: Combined total = yellow + green + HVFHV; each component has different trend (yellow/green roughly flat or declining, HVFHV growing then plateauing). Estimating each component separately and summing reduces aggregation error and lets us use class-specific recent data.
candidates.data_to_find: Recent monthly trip counts separately for yellow taxi, green taxi, and HVFHV for the latest available months before cutoff and for prior Octobers. Minimum: latest 6-12 months by class; substitute TLC summary reports if raw Parquet not yet processed.
search_hints: TLC HVFHV trips per month 2025 2026
yellow taxi trips per month NYC 2025
green taxi boro taxi monthly trips NYC

candidates.perspective: Broader for-hire vehicle universe and share bridge
candidates.hypothesis: Total FHV/taxi trips (all classes) times the share attributable to yellow+green+HVFHV gives the target; the excluded classes (black car, livery, luxury) are a small and slowly changing share, so a stable share can bridge.
candidates.data_to_find: Total trips across all TLC-licensed vehicle classes for recent months and the share of yellow+green+HVFHV; or counts of active FHV vehicles by class to gauge the excluded share. Minimum: one recent month's class breakdown.

extra_directions.hypothesis: A monthly TLC summary or trip-record total for yellow+green+HVFHV in mid-2026 (e.g., June-August 2026) would anchor the level immediately before the target month, replacing the Sept-2025 secondary anchor (p23/p24) and the Feb-2026 HVFHV anchor (p46). methods.rationale: Combined daily total = Sept-2025 ride-hail/day (p23) + Sept-2025 taxi/day (p24), scaled to October 2026 by a1. p23 and p24 come from one secondary source but are the most recent combined-scope anchors; a1 carries trend, October seasonality, and congestion-pricing effects. methods.rationale: Component sum: HVFHV from Feb-2026 monthly total (p46) converted to daily via k_days_target and scaled by a2; yellow+green from Sept-2025 daily level (p24) scaled by a3. Uses the most recent HVFHV-specific anchor (p46) rather than the older p23, giving an independent route to the combined total. Failure mode: p46 is a single newsbreak figure; a2/a3 carry the extrapolation uncertainty.

assumptions.name: October 2026 combined daily trips relative to Sept 2025 combined daily level
assumptions.rationale: Bridges the Sept-2025 combined anchor (p23+p24) to October 2026, absorbing ~13 months of trend, October seasonality, and congestion-pricing effects. Centered near 1.0 because HVFHV growth has plateaued (p12, p46 ~99% of pre-2020) and taxi is roughly flat; wide range reflects the absence of a 2026 combined observation.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to scale the Sept-2025 combined daily level to October 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A published 2026 monthly combined total showing a level well outside the 0.85-1.18 band relative to Sept 2025.

assumptions.name: October 2026 HVFHV daily trips relative to Feb 2026 HVFHV daily level
assumptions.rationale: Bridges the Feb-2026 HVFHV anchor (p46, 19.8M/28 days) to October 2026, absorbing trend and October-vs-February seasonality. Centered near 1.0 given plateaued HVFHV growth; wide range for missing 2026 monthly data.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to scale Feb-2026 HVFHV daily level to October 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A 2026 HVFHV monthly total showing a level outside the 0.85-1.18 band relative to February 2026.

assumptions.name: October 2026 yellow+green daily trips relative to Sept 2025 taxi daily level
assumptions.rationale: Bridges the Sept-2025 taxi anchor (p24, 138,644/day, yellow+green) to October 2026, absorbing trend and October seasonality. Centered near 1.0 given roughly flat taxi volumes (p15 +7.5% in 2024, p39 green tiny); wide range for missing 2026 data.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to scale Sept-2025 taxi daily level to October 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A 2026 taxi monthly total showing a level outside the 0.85-1.18 band relative to September 2025.

assessment.note: Both indicate yellow-taxi trips were rising into 2024 (October 2024 at 3.8M, +7.5% for CY2024); same TLC-derived source family, so not independent, but consistent in direction and level.
HVFHV 2023 ~232M, 2024 ~239M, +3% — internally consistent; same TLC release, so one underlying measurement.
All-industry 2024 total >300M decomposes plausibly into HVFHV 239M + non-HVFHV FHV 19.7M + taxi (~40M implied); consistent accounting, same source.
September 2025 ride-hail ~647,819/day and taxi ~138,644/day; combined ~786k/day. Third-party aggregation of TLC data; consistent with 2024 annual levels (~239M HVFHV ≈ 655k/day).
February 2026 HVFHV 19.8M (~707k/day) and green cab 1,304/day; both from TLC data reported in same article. HVFHV Feb 2026 is above 2025 run-rate, suggesting continued modest growth.

Apparent tension: Sep 2025 ride-hail ~648k/day vs Feb 2026 HVFHV ~707k/day. Resolvable by definition (ride-hail may exclude some HVFHV or be a different month/season) and by growth; treat as a level range rather than contradiction.

Congestion-pricing period shows yellow taxi up sharply (~17% citywide Jan 2025) and FHV up modestly (~3.8%); same NY1 report, one measurement. Indicates taxi rebound and FHV near-flat, not a large FHV decline.
Active taxi counts (9,768 Dec 2024 vs 11,315 Mar 2020) show fleet shrinkage; contextual for capacity route, not a trip count.
2015 (11-13M/mo) vs 2019 (6-8M/mo) taxi trips show long-run decline; historical, not directly transferable to 2026 level but useful as trend context.

a1.role: October 2026 HVFHV level relative to February 2026

a2.role: Yellow+green taxi trips per day in NYC, October 2026

methods.rationale: Decomposition using the observed February 2026 HVFHV monthly total (p46) converted to a daily rate and seasonally/trend-adjusted to October 2026 via a1, plus the taxi+green daily component a2 (anchored on p24 Sep 2025 taxi and p39 Feb 2026 green, adjusted for recovery per p1/p15/p55). Sums to the combined target. Shared dependency: both components rely on TLC-derived third-party reporting; failure mode is a large post-2025 regime shift (e.g., congestion pricing or policy) not captured by the anchors, and a1 seasonality transfer uncertainty from a single month.

assumptions.name: October 2026 HVFHV level relative to February 2026
assumptions.rationale: October is near or slightly below the annual mean for combined taxi/HVFHV trips; February 2026 is a winter month with a modest seasonal dip, so October 2026 should be roughly at or modestly above the February level, with trend growth offsetting seasonality. Range reflects uncertainty in seasonality and trend.
assumptions.applies_when: Transferring the February 2026 HVFHV level (p46) to October 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that October combined trips are materially below winter levels or that HVFHV volume has declined sharply since early 2026.

assumptions.name: Yellow+green taxi daily trips in October 2026
assumptions.rationale: September 2025 taxi ~138,644/day (p24) plus green ~1,304/day (p39); yellow taxi has been recovering (p1, p15, p55), so October 2026 likely near or slightly above the Sep 2025 level. Range spans flat-to-recovering.
assumptions.applies_when: Used as the taxi+green component in the combined sum for October 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: TLC data showing yellow/green taxi daily trips well outside 115k-165k in mid/late 2026.

kept.rationale: October is near or slightly below the annual mean for combined taxi/HVFHV trips; February 2026 is a winter month with a modest seasonal dip, so October 2026 should be roughly at or modestly above the February level, with trend growth offsetting seasonality. Range reflects uncertainty in seasonality
kept.applies_when: Transferring the February 2026 HVFHV level (p46) to October 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that October combined trips are materially below winter levels or that HVFHV volume has declined sharply since early 2026.

kept.name: Yellow+green taxi daily trips in October 2026
kept.rationale: September 2025 taxi ~138,644/day (p24) plus green ~1,304/day (p39); yellow taxi has been recovering (p1, p15, p55), so October 2026 likely near or slightly above the Sep 2025 level. Range spans flat-to-recovering.
kept.applies_when: Used as the taxi+green component in the combined sum for October 2026.
kept.falsified_by: TLC data showing yellow/green taxi daily trips well outside 115k-165k in mid/late 2026.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
